title: Centralized Configuration and API Gateway in Microservices
Microservices Architecture with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Overview
tldr: This lecture outlines building a microservices architecture using Spring Boot and Spring Cloud with an Employee Management example featuring Employee, Department, and Organization services each with its own database. It previews key patterns to be implemented including inter-service communication with RestTemplate, WebClient and OpenFeign, service discovery, centralized configuration, API Gateway, distributed tracing, and the circuit breaker pattern to handle service failures.
